Carnegie Mellon 2026-27 tuition: $69,702

Princeton: SAT optional for fall 2027

At Princeton, the SAT/ACT is optional for fall 2026 and 2027 entry and required again for fall 2028. You need two teacher references and one counselor reference. If your schooling is not in English, a language test is required, no minimum. Regular deadline: 1 January.

Source: admission.princeton.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

“uni-assist is free and you only apply once”

The truth: You pay per program and per semester. First program €75, each extra program in the same semester €30. You pay again in a new semester. VPD (preliminary review) takes 4-6 weeks and is valid for one year.

Source: uni-assist.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Diploma document for Italy: CIMEA or Dichiarazione di Valore?

1. There are two routes: The circular recognizes two routes: CIMEA (equivalence center) documents or the Dichiarazione di Valore. The university chooses.
2. What universities say: Bari Polytechnic and Verona accept both. At Florence, you need one before enrollment (2024/25 page).
3. For visa-exempt applicants: Turkish passport holders are not in this group. The circular recommends not asking visa-exempt applicants for the Dichiarazione.
4. Allow time: Request documents early. For high school, the visa file needs the original diploma and, if required, an Italian translation.

In Lisbon Convention countries (Türkiye included), the CIMEA comparability document can be downloaded from the ARDI site.

Source: unife.it, poliba.it, univr.it, unifi.it, en.unimib.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Non-EU? In the Netherlands, the deadline is not 1 May everywhere

Numerus fixus: 15 January (programs with limited places, 23:59)
Tilburg master's: 1 April (September 2027 entry)
Rotterdam UAS: 1 April (non-EU bachelor's and autumn master's)
Aeres UAS: 1 April (non-EU; applications open on 1 October)
Breda UAS: 1 May (bachelor's; master's 1 June)
Hanze UAS: 1 June (September entry; February entry 1 November)

Most pages do not state a year. The dates repeat each year, but confirm 2027 with the university. The general Studielink date is 1 May.

Source: studyinnl.org, tilburguniversity.edu, rotterdamuas.com, aeresuas.com, buas.nl, hanze.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

When do winter semester applications open in Germany?

RWTH Aachen master's: 1 December-1 March (non-EU, open admission; limited places 15 July)
Göttingen bachelor's: 1 March-30 April (limited places; open admission 30 September)
HPI master's: 1 April-1 June (GRE General Test required)
TU Dresden: 1 April-31 May (non-EU, foreign diploma)
Hamburg master's: 1 May-15 June (2026/27; international 15 February-31 March)

These windows recur and no year is stated. Confirm them for 2027/28. Add 8 weeks for the uni-assist preliminary review document (VPD).

Source: rwth-aachen.de, uni-goettingen.de, hpi.de, tu-dresden.de, uni-hamburg.de, uni-assist.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
